# Initialize the AFM system
import nanosurf

# Access scan and control objects
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode
zctrl = app.ZController

# ----- Configure scan parameters -----
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6   # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters

scan.Lines = 128          # lines per frame
# Center the scan at the current tip position (optional)
# scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
# scan.CenterPosY = 0.0

    opmode.Mode = opmode.ModeEnum.Tapping  # Preferred enum access
except Exception:
    opmode.Mode = "Tapping"               # Fallback string assignment

# ----- Set Z‑controller set‑point and gains (conservative values) -----
zctrl.SetPoint = 0.5   # 0.5 V (typical for gentle feedback)
zctrl.PGain = 1000     # Reduced proportional gain to avoid tip damage
zctrl.IGain = 500      # Reduced integral gain

# ----- Start the scan -----
scan.Start()
# Wait until the scan finishes
scan.WaitForCompletion()

# ----- Save the image -----
# The application usually provides an Image object with a Save method.
# Save to the default results folder; the method returns the full path.
image_path = app.Image.Save()  # Returns absolute path of the saved image file
print(image_path)

# Clean up the COM object
del spm"
}
